layout.structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 h-screen w-full overflow-hidden bg-[#05050A] text-white

sections.hero_left: col-span-1 md:col-span-8 relative flex items-center justify-center bg-[url('https://images.pexels.com/photos/7562087/pexels-photo-7562087.jpeg')] bg-cover bg-center before:content-[''] before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-[#05050A]/90 before:backdrop-blur-[2px]
sections.chat_right: col-span-1 md:col-span-4 h-full bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-2xl border-l border-white/10 flex flex-col relative z-10 shadow-[-20px_0_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]

sphere.wrapper: relative flex items-center justify-center w-64 h-64 md:w-80 md:h-80 z-20
sphere.core: absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-[#ffffff] via-[#E0F2FE] to-[#007AFF] shadow-[inset_0_-20px_40px_rgba(0,122,255,0.6),_0_0_40px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)]
sphere.aura_layer_1: absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-[#00E5FF] mix-blend-screen blur-[20px] opacity-60

states.idle: Soft breathing animation. Scale from 1 to 1.02. Low glow.
states.listening: Aura expands and contracts rapidly. Rings scale up. Inner shadow pulses intensely.
states.speaking: Audio-reactive behavior (simulated). Multi-layered blue aura waves emitting outward like ripples. High blur and opacity on the cyan glow.

chat_panel.container: flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 flex flex-col gap-6 custom-scrollbar
chat_panel.user_bubble: self-end max-w-[85%] bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-5 py-3 text-white font-sans text-sm border border-white/20 shadow-lg
chat_panel.ai_bubble: self-start max-w-[85%] bg-transparent text-[#00E5FF] px-2 py-3 text-sm font-sans tracking-wide leading-relaxed
chat_panel.header: h-20 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between px-6 shrink-0
chat_panel.input_area: p-6 border-t border-white/10 shrink-0 bg-[#05050A]/50 backdrop-blur-md

status_indicator.container: absolute top-8 left-8 flex items-center gap-3 bg-white/5 border border-white/10 px-4 py-2 rounded-full backdrop-blur-md

motion.sphere_breathing: Use framer-motion variants for the sphere container. animate={{ scale: [1, 1.02, 1], boxShadow: [...] }} transition={{ duration: 4, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
motion.aura_ripples: Render 2-3 absolute divs behind the sphere. When speaking, animate them with scale from 1 to 1.8 and opacity from 0.8 to 0. Repeat infinite.
motion.chat_reveal: New messages slide up (y: 20 -> 0) and fade in (opacity: 0 -> 1) using framer-motion.

background_texture.description: Used as a very faint, highly darkened overlay on the left hero side to give a tech/lab environment texture rather than flat black.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts.
Use Lucide React or Phosphor Icons for UI elements like mic, settings, clear chat.
The layout MUST be split: left side (sphere) taking ~65% width, right side (chat) taking ~35%. On mobile, stack them vertically but keep the sphere prominent.
The Sphere MUST be predominantly white with blue gradients/shadows to match the prompt 'esfera blanca con azul'.
The Aura MUST be blue/cyan ('aura color azul'). Use multiple stacked blurred divs with absolute positioning to create a convincing light emanation effect.
In the chat, Jarvis's responses should not look like standard bubbles; they should look like clean glowing text or minimalist terminal output to contrast the user's glassmorphic bubble.
Implement Shadcn Select for the Gemini Model dropdown in the chat header.
Include a 'Live Transcript' or 'Status' visual cue on the left side near the sphere when the user is speaking.
DO NOT use generic purple/pink gradients. Stick strictly to Obsidian, White, and Electric Blue/Cyan.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
